recipe.text: Falchion: distinct from prior gladius/dagger/spear/scimitar rungs. Cube prompt 'falchion cleaver, narrow at guard broadening toward tip, clipped machete tip' produced the right silhouette after one regen; mesh shipped 31 studs long so MeshPart.Size was rescaled directly to 3.4 studs before judging. Grip needed rx=180 flip (blade initially pointed into the leg) with hilt offset z=+1.2. Swing is a fast overhead chop: 0.7s arm-only clip matching the 0.12/0.18 windup/active window; hitbox 20 dmg reach 6 server-cooldown 0.35s.
